data.title: Mobile Developer
data.summary: The role involves developing iOS and Android mobile applications, including digital identity and credential features. It also covers mobile security capabilities such as NFC, biometric authentication and secure storage.

requirements.text: At least five years of mobile application development experience
requirements.question: Would someone who has done mobile application development, with fewer than 5 years, be worth a conversation?
requirements.why: The posting asks for extensive hands-on mobile application development experience.

requirements.text: Experience from at least five completed iOS and Android mobile projects
Experience with digital identity, eID, mobile wallets or digital credentials
Experience with NFC, biometrics, secure key storage or secure mobile data storage

requirements.question: Is Finnish needed from day one, or could someone start in English and build up Finnish on the job?
requirements.why: Fluent spoken and written Finnish is listed as mandatory.
